{{Current events|year=2018|month=12|day=11|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Strasbourg attack]]
**A gunman kills two people and injures 14 others in a mass shooting in [[Strasbourg]], [[France]], during the annual [[Christkindelsmärik, Strasbourg|Christmas market]]. The shooter flees the scene but is identified by police as a known extremist. The incident is being treated as an act of terrorism. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46530265 (BBC)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/12/11/latest-several-injured-shots-fired-strasbourg-christmas-market/ (The Daily Telegraph)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/11/strasbourg-shooting-in-eastern-france (The Guardian)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Five [[U.S. Marines]] who were missing after two aircraft collided mid-air off the coast of [[Japan]] on December 6 are declared dead. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/12/11/national/five-u-s-marines-missing-aircraft-collision-off-kochi-prefecture-declared-dead/#.XA-lLTNCeUk (The Japan Times)]

;International relations
*[[Philippines–United States relations]]
**The [[Balangiga bells]], stolen during the [[Balangiga massacre|massacre]] in [[Balangiga, Eastern Samar|Balangiga]] in 1901 during the [[Philippine–American War]], were returned to the Philippines after 117 years under the possession of the United States. [http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2018/12/11/Balangiga-bells-back-PH.html (CNN Philippines)]

;Law and crime
*[[Campinas Cathedral shooting]]
**A gunman kills four people and injures four others at a Catholic [[Our Lady of the Conception Cathedral, Campinas|cathedral]] in [[Campinas]], [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. The gunman commits suicide after the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46529733 (BBC)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/five-dead-four-wounded-shooting-catholic-cathedral-brazil-n946551 (NBC News)]
*[[Cannabis in New Zealand]]
**[[New Zealand]]'s government passes an amendment to the [[Misuse of Drugs Act 1975]] to allow chronic and terminally ill patients to use [[medical cannabis]] without facing the possibility of prosecution. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/11/new-zealand-passes-laws-to-make-medical-marijuana-widely-available (''The Guardian'')]
*In the [[United Kingdom]], a man is [[Taser|tasered]] by police at the gates of the [[Palace of Westminster]]. The area is placed on lockdown. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/12/11/breaking-man-tasered-police-gates-parliament/ (Daily Telegraph)]
*[[Bill Cosby sexual assault cases]]
**The lawyers of [[Bill Cosby]] file a list of nearly a dozen alleged trial errors as they appeal his sexual assault conviction and three-to-10-year prison term. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/bill-cosby-lawyers-detail-11-alleged-trial-errors-as-they-appeal/ (CBS News)]
*[[Meng Wanzhou#Detention|Detention of Meng Wanzhou]]
**[[Meng Wanzhou]], CFO of Huawei who was arrested in Canada for a [[extradition]] request from the United States for alleged US sanction violation against Iran, is granted bail with restrictions by a [[Canada|Canadian]] judge. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/huawei-meng-wanzhou-bail-hearing-vancouver-1.4940849 (CBC)]
**[[International Crisis Group]] confirm one of it's worker Michael Kovrig is detained in People's Republic of China. Kovrig is a former Canadian diplomat and his detainment come after the PRC warned Canada of severe consequences if Meng was not released. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-icg/former-canadian-diplomat-detained-in-china-sources-idUSKBN1OA1EB (reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*Thousands of students at the [[University of Tirana]] in [[Albania]] demonstrate against tuition fees. The government appeals for calm. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-12-11/thousands-of-albanian-students-step-up-rally-against-fees (AP via ''U.S. News & World Report'')]
